summary: Verified SPA-serving fix on FastAPI backend at :8001. All 18 new tests (SPA root, JS bundle, favicon, SPA fallback for unknown routes, API not shadowed by catch-all, root-level health endpoints) PASS. Full regression suite: 157/157 PASS (139 prior + 18 new). Backend correctly serves Expo web build at /, /_expo/*, /assets/*, /favicon.ico, and SPA fallback (/complaints, /help, /random-route, deep/nested) — while /api/* JSON routes and /health, /healthz remain intact. /api/nonexistent returns proper JSON 404 (not HTML SPA fallback). Catch-all route ordering is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: SPA catch-all in server.py correctly checks startswith(('api/','api','health','healthz','_expo/','assets/')) — note 'api' (no slash) is a defensive match but unreachable in practice since /api/ is mounted via include_router and intercepts everything before catch-all. Harmless.
HEAD / returns 405 (only GET defined). Intentional per agent note; not a bug. K8s probes use GET on /health so unaffected.
server.py is ~1660 lines — still over 700 LOC threshold from coding standards. Consider modular split in future, but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded demo accounts (9000000002/demo1234).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA serving is solid. Next agent can re-use /app/backend/tests/test_spa_serving_iter9.py to regression-check the catch-all if the route table changes. Full suite runs in ~37s.
rca_of_issue: n/a — verification task. Original deployment 404 was because backend at /api/* did not serve a frontend. Fix mounts Expo dist/ statically + SPA catch-all at end of FastAPI app. Verified the catch-all does not shadow /api/* (api routes are registered first via include_router) and excludes _expo/, assets/, health/healthz prefixes.
